description: Against a migrated database, exercise seat apply and remove on an editable ticket and project task, including removing the last MSP-applied mapping. Reload and verify the mapping changes and the definition survives.
Exercise the server actions with a non-editable target, an out-of-scope or wrong-type tag, and attempted definition management. Verify denied writes leave mappings and definitions intact.
Exercise the task dialog with an eligible tag, no eligible tags, all choices already applied, and a read-only task. Verify picker behavior, removable applied tags, and the empty-state message.
